title: What Can Deep Learning Be Used For

cues.en: How'd you go?
cues.zh: 做得如何？

cues.en: Did you do some research?
cues.zh: 有研究一下嗎？

cues.en: Did you find out what deep learning is actually used for?
cues.zh: 找出深度學習實際用在哪裡了嗎？

cues.en: I bet you found a treasure trail of things.
cues.zh: 我猜你找到了一串寶藏。

cues.en: And, hey, I mean, if you're in this course, chances are that you probably already know some use cases for deep learning.
cues.zh: 如果已經來上這門課，很可能本來就知道一些深度學習的使用情境。

cues.en: You're like, Daniel, hurry up and get to the code.
cues.zh: 你可能想說，Daniel，快點開始寫程式。

cues.en: Well, we're going to get there, don't you worry.
cues.zh: 我們會進入那裡，不用擔心。

cues.en: But let's have a look at some things that deep learning can be used for.
cues.zh: 但先看看深度學習能做哪些事情。

cues.en: But before I just want to remind you of this comment, this is from Yasha Swee on the 2020 Machine Learning Roadmap video.
cues.zh: 不過在那之前，想再提醒你這則留言，來自〈2020 機器學習路線圖〉影片的這位留言者，來源姓名拼寫不清。

cues.en: I think you can use ML and remember ML is machine learning and remember deep learning is a part of ML for literally anything as long as you can convert it into numbers and program it to find patterns.
cues.zh: 「我認為可以使用 ML」，記得 ML 是機器學習，深度學習是 ML 的一部分，「只要能轉成數字，並寫程式找出模式，幾乎任何事都能用。」

cues.en: Literally it could be anything, any input or output from the universe.
cues.zh: 真的是任何東西，宇宙裡的任何輸入或輸出。

cues.en: So that's a beautiful thing about machine learning is that if you can encode it something into numbers, chances are you can build a machine learning algorithm to find patterns in those numbers.
cues.zh: 這就是機器學習美妙之處，如果能把某個東西編碼成數字，很可能就能建立機器學習演算法，找出數字裡的模式。

cues.en: Will it work?
cues.zh: 它會成功嗎？

cues.en: Well, again, that's the reason machine learning and deep learning is part art, part science.
cues.zh: 這也是機器學習與深度學習，一部分像藝術、一部分像科學的原因。

cues.en: A scientist would love to know that their experiments would work, but an artist is kind of excited about the fact that, I don't know, this might work, it might not.
cues.zh: 科學家很想知道實驗會成功，但藝術家有點享受這種，不知道可能成功、也可能不成功的感覺。

cues.en: And so that's something to keep in mind.
cues.zh: 所以要記住這點，

cues.en: Along with the rule number one of machine learning is if you don't need it, you don't use it.
cues.zh: 也記得機器學習第一條規則，如果不需要，就不要用。

cues.en: But if you do use it, it can be used for almost anything.
cues.zh: 但如果要用，幾乎什麼都能用。

cues.en: And let's get a little bit specific and find out some deep learning use cases.
cues.zh: 具體一點，看看一些深度學習的使用情境。

cues.en: And I've put some up there for a reason because there are lots these are just some that I interact with in my day to day life, such as recommendation.
cues.zh: 我這裡寫「一些」是有原因的，因為有非常多。這些只是我日常會接觸的，例如推薦。

cues.en: We've got a programming video, we've got a programming podcast, we got some jujitsu videos, we've got some Runescape videos, a soundtrack from my favorite movie.
cues.zh: 有程式設計影片、程式設計 Podcast、柔術影片、RuneScape 影片，還有我最喜歡電影的配樂。

cues.en: Have you noticed whenever you go to YouTube, you don't really search for things anymore?
cues.zh: 你有沒有發現，每次上 YouTube，已經不太需要搜尋？

cues.en: Well, sometimes you might, but the recommendation page is pretty darn good.
cues.zh: 有時也許還會，但推薦頁面真的很厲害，

cues.en: That's all powered by deep learning.
cues.zh: 背後都是深度學習。

cues.en: And in the last ten years, have you noticed that translation has got pretty good too?
cues.zh: 過去十年，你有沒有注意到翻譯也變得相當好？

cues.en: Well, that's powered by deep learning as well.
cues.zh: 背後也是深度學習。

cues.en: Now, I don't have much hands on experience with this.
cues.zh: 我沒有太多這方面的實作經驗，

cues.en: I did use it when I was in Japan.
cues.zh: 去日本的時候用過，

cues.en: I speak a very little amount of Japanese and an even smaller amount of Mandarin.
cues.zh: 我只會一點點日語，中文就更少。

cues.en: But if I wanted to translate deep learning as epic to Spanish, it might come out as l a brain disease,
cues.zh: 如果想把「Deep learning is epic」翻成西班牙文，可能會變成，el aprendizaje，

cues.en: the disease profundo as a pickle.
cues.zh: profundo es épico。

cues.en: Now, all of the native Spanish speakers watching this video can laugh at me because that was a very Australian version of saying deep learning is epic in Spanish.
cues.zh: 所有正在看影片的西班牙文母語者都可以笑我，因為那是用非常澳洲的方式，說西班牙文的「深度學習太棒了」。

cues.en: But that's so cool.
cues.zh: 但這很酷，

cues.en: All of Google Translate is now powered by deep learning.
cues.zh: Google 翻譯現在全部由深度學習支援。

cues.en: And the beautiful thing, if I if I couldn't say it myself, I could click this speaker and it would say it for me.
cues.zh: 而且很棒的是，如果我自己不會念，可以點這個喇叭，它會念給我聽，

cues.en: So that's speech recognition.
cues.zh: 這就是語音辨識，

cues.en: That's powered by deep learning.
cues.zh: 背後是深度學習。

cues.en: So if you were to ask your voice assistant, who is the biggest big dog of them all.
cues.zh: 所以如果問語音助理：「誰是全世界最厲害的大人物？」

cues.en: Of course they're going to say you, which is what I've set up my voice assistant to say.
cues.zh: 當然會說是你，這是我設定語音助理要說的內容。

cues.en: That's part of speech recognition and in computer vision.
cues.zh: 這是語音辨識的一部分，接著是電腦視覺。

cues.en: Oh, look at this.
cues.zh: 喔，看看這個，

cues.en: You see this?
cues.zh: 看到了嗎？

cues.en: Where is this photo from?
cues.zh: 這張照片從哪來？

cues.en: This photo is from this person driving this car.
cues.zh: 這張照片裡開這輛車的人，

cues.en: Did a hit and run on my car at the front of my house, my apartment building.
cues.zh: 在我家、公寓大樓前面撞了我的車，然後肇事逃逸。

cues.en: My car was parked on the street.
cues.zh: 我的車停在路邊，

cues.en: This car, the trailer came off, ran into the back of my car, basically destroyed it, and then they drove off.
cues.zh: 這輛車的拖車脫落，撞上我的車後方，基本上把車撞毀，然後他們就開走了。

cues.en: However, my next door neighbor's security camera picked up on this car.
cues.zh: 不過隔壁鄰居的監視攝影機，拍到了這輛車。

cues.en: Now, I became a detective for a week and I thought, Hmm, if there was a computer vision algorithm built into that camera, it could have detected when the car hit.
cues.zh: 我當了一星期偵探，想著，如果攝影機內建電腦視覺演算法，就能偵測車子什麼時候撞上來。

cues.en: I mean, it took a lot of searching to find.
cues.zh: 我花了很多時間才找到，

cues.en: It Turns out the car hit about 3:30 a.m. in the morning, so it's pitch black.
cues.zh: 結果大約是凌晨三點半撞上的，所以一片漆黑。

cues.en: And of course, we didn't get the license plate.
cues.zh: 當然，沒有拍到車牌，

cues.en: So this person is out there somewhere in the world after doing a hit and run.
cues.zh: 所以這個肇事逃逸的人，現在還在世界某個地方。

cues.en: So if you're watching this video, just remember computer vision might catch you one day.
cues.zh: 如果你正在看這支影片，記住，電腦視覺總有一天可能抓到你。

cues.en: So this is called object detection, where you would place a box around the area where the pixels most represent the object that you're looking for.
cues.zh: 這叫做物件偵測，在像素最能代表你要找的物件的區域，畫上一個框。

cues.en: So for computer vision, we could train an object detector to capture cars that drive past a certain camera.
cues.zh: 電腦視覺可以訓練物件偵測器，擷取經過某個攝影機的汽車。

cues.en: And then if someone does a hit and run on you, you could capture it.
cues.zh: 如果有人撞了你卻逃逸，就能記錄下來。

cues.en: And then fingers crossed, it's not too dark that you can read the license plate and go, Hey, excuse me, Police.
cues.zh: 希望不要太暗，能讀到車牌，然後說：「不好意思，警察，

cues.en: This person has hit my car and wrecked it.
cues.zh: 這個人撞了我的車，把它撞壞了。」

cues.en: So that's a very close to home story of where computer vision could be used.
cues.zh: 這是電腦視覺能派上用場，一個與我切身相關的故事。

cues.en: And then finally, natural language processing.
cues.zh: 最後，自然語言處理。

cues.en: Have you noticed as well your spam detector on your email inbox is pretty darn good?
cues.zh: 你有沒有發現，電子郵件收件匣的垃圾郵件偵測器，也相當厲害？

cues.en: Well, some are powered by deep learning, some not.
cues.zh: 有些靠深度學習，有些不是。

cues.en: It's hard to tell these days what is powered by deep learning, what isn't.
cues.zh: 現在很難看出哪些由深度學習支援，哪些不是。

cues.en: But natural language processing is the process of looking at natural language text, so unstructured text.
cues.zh: 自然語言處理，是查看自然語言文字，也就是非結構化文字的過程，

cues.en: So whatever you'd write an email in a story, in a Wikipedia document and deciding or getting your algorithm to find patterns in that.
cues.zh: 例如電子郵件、故事、維基百科文件裡會寫的內容，再判斷，或讓演算法找出裡面的模式。

cues.en: So for this example, you would find that this email is not spam.
cues.zh: 這個例子會判定，這封郵件不是垃圾郵件。

cues.en: This deep learning course is incredible.
cues.zh: 「這門深度學習課太棒了，

cues.en: I can't wait to use what I've learned.
cues.zh: 我迫不及待想用學到的內容，

cues.en: Thank you so much.
cues.zh: 非常感謝。」

cues.en: And by the way, that is my real email.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，那真的是我的電子郵件地址，

cues.en: So if you want to email me, you can.
cues.zh: 所以想寫信給我，可以寄到那裡。

cues.en: And then this is spam.
cues.zh: 這個則是垃圾郵件：

cues.en: Hey, Danielle, congratulations.
cues.zh: 「嗨，Daniel，恭喜，

cues.en: You win a lot of money.
cues.zh: 你贏得一大筆錢。」

cues.en: Wow, I really like that.
cues.zh: 哇，我真喜歡，

cues.en: A lot of money.
cues.zh: 一大筆錢。

cues.en: But for some reason I don't think that this is real.
cues.zh: 但不知道為什麼，我覺得這不是真的，

cues.en: So that would probably go to my spam inbox.
cues.zh: 所以大概會進垃圾郵件匣。

cues.en: Now.
cues.zh: 現在，

cues.en: With that being said.
cues.zh: 話說回來，

cues.en: If we wanted to put these problems in a little bit more of a classification.
cues.zh: 如果要替這些問題稍微分類一下，

cues.en: This is known as sequence to sequence because you put one sequence in and get one sequence out.
cues.zh: 這叫做序列到序列，因為輸入一個序列，輸出一個序列。

cues.en: Same as this.
cues.zh: 這個也一樣，

cues.en: You have a sequence of audio waves and you get some text out.
cues.zh: 有一段音波序列，再得到一些文字，

cues.en: So sequence to sequence SEC to sec.
cues.zh: 所以是序列到序列，seq2seq。

cues.en: This is classification regression.
cues.zh: 這個是分類與迴歸，

cues.en: In this case, the regression is predicting a number.
cues.zh: 這裡的迴歸，是預測一個數字，

cues.en: That's what a regression problem is.
cues.zh: 迴歸問題就是這樣。

cues.en: You would predict the coordinates of where these box corners should be.
cues.zh: 要預測這些方框角落應該在哪裡的座標，

cues.en: So say there should be at however many pixels in from the x angle and however many pixels down from the Y angle that's that corner.
cues.zh: 例如沿 x 方向往內多少像素、沿 y 方向往下多少像素，就是那個角。

cues.en: And then you would draw in between the corners and then the classification part would go, Hey, this is that car that did a hit and run on us.
cues.zh: 再把角落連起來，分類部分則會說，這就是撞了我們又逃逸的那輛車。

cues.en: And in this case this is classification.
cues.zh: 這個例子則是分類，

cues.en: Classification is predicting whether something is one thing or another or perhaps more than one thing or another in the class of multiclass classification.
cues.zh: 分類是預測某個東西屬於這一類或另一類，或者多類別分類時，可能有更多類別。

cues.en: So this email is not spam.
cues.zh: 所以這封郵件不是垃圾郵件，

cues.en: That's a class, and this email is spam.
cues.zh: 那是一個類別；這封是垃圾郵件，

cues.en: So that's also a class.
cues.zh: 也是一個類別。

cues.en: So I think we've only got one direction to go now that we've sort of laid the foundation for the course.
cues.zh: 現在已經替這門課打好一些基礎，我想接下來只剩一個方向，

cues.en: And that is, well, let's start talking about PyTorch.
cues.zh: 就是開始談 PyTorch。

cues.en: I'll see you in the next video.
cues.zh: 下支影片見。
